TH_P.statement: f_0 = (1,1,1)/sqrt3 is a common eigenvector of the six position permutations, hence of every operator in their algebra and of Y Y^dag for every such Y; with tau on f_0 the tau row and one column of U_PMNS are unit vectors: two of the three angles are 0 or 90 degrees

TH_M.statement: for M_R = alpha + beta (S + S^-1) the light masses are lambda_0^2/abs(alpha + 2 beta) on f_0 and lambda_1 lambda_2/abs(alpha - beta) twice on (f_1, f_2): the electron and muon characters form a degenerate pair for every alpha, beta

M2_note: pairing a copy with its half-turn image is the identity pairing of the characters: masses lambda_k^2, U a permutation
